title: Social Media Memes and AI Transform World Cup Experience Despite Controversy
description: The 2026 World Cup has become one of the most enjoyable in recent memory, despite controversies over ticket prices, travel, and political interference, thanks to a wave of social media memes and AI-generated content. From viral videos of Erling Haaland and Jude Bellingham to AI depictions of Lionel Messi as 'Fifa's Princess', online platforms have democratized the tournament, attracting new fans and creating unprecedented engagement.
